workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots they have free next week. Please check if Elena and David are available in any of these slots.

*   Mon Nov 16: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM
*   Tue Nov 17: 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM, 4:30 PM
*   Wed Nov 18: 3:00 PM, 3:30 PM
*   Thu Nov 19: 10:00 AM
*   Fri Nov 20: 11:00 AM, 11:30 AM

Let me know what you find.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, thanks for sending those slots over. I've checked Elena's and David's calendars and unfortunately none of the times you suggested work for them.

To make it easier, I've found the times that Elena and David are both free for a 30-minute meeting next week. Here they are:

* Mon Nov 16: 11:00 AM, 11:30 AM
* Tue Nov 17: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM
* Wed Nov 18: 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM
* Thu Nov 19: 9:30 AM, 2:30 PM, 3:00 PM

Please check if any of these work for Priya and Marcus. Let me know!

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've checked the times you sent against Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Unfortunately, none of them work.

To give us a better chance of finding a match, I'm sharing the full list of available 30-minute slots for each of them. Can you please compare these with Elena's and David's calendars?

Priya's free times:
* Mon: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM, 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM
* Tue: 10:30 AM, 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM, 2:30 PM, 4:30 PM
* Wed: 12:30 PM, 3:00 PM, 3:30 PM
* Thu: 9:00 AM, 10:00 AM, 1:00 PM, 2:30 PM
* Fri: 11:00 AM, 11:30 AM, 1:00 PM, 2:00 PM

Marcus's free times:
* Mon: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM, 11:00 AM, 3:00 PM
* Tue: 11:00 AM, 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM, 3:30 PM, 4:30 PM
* Wed: 9:00 AM, 12:00 PM, 2:00 PM, 3:00 PM, 3:30 PM
* Thu: 10:00 AM, 12:00 PM, 1:30 PM
* Fri: 11:00 AM, 11:30 AM, 2:30 PM

Hopefully this helps us find a time that works for all four. Let me know.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've found a time that works for everyone: Thursday, November 19 at 2:30 PM. I've sent the confirmation email to the partners. Please create the booking in the system. Thanks for your help!

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, thanks for the update. I'm glad you found a time.

However, I've double-checked the calendars and I see a conflict. Marcus Hale has a dentist appointment at 2:30 PM on Thursday, so he is not available. Please do not create the booking for this time. You will need to send a follow-up email to the partners to cancel that meeting time.

Let's find a new time. Can you please check if Tuesday, November 17 at 4:30 PM works for Elena and David? Both Priya and Marcus are free at that time.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I am so sorry about that. I misread Marcus's availability. I will send a cancellation email to the partners immediately for the Thursday 2:30 PM meeting.

Regarding your suggestion of Tuesday at 4:30 PM, unfortunately, that time does not work as Elena has a conflict.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
I've conducted a thorough review of everyone's calendars, and it appears there are no common 30-minute slots available for all four partners next week.

Could you please check with Priya and Marcus to see if they have any flexibility in their schedules? Perhaps one of them could move a less urgent meeting to free up some time. If you can find a potential slot on their end, I can then check with Elena and David. Let me know what you think.

emails.body: Hi team, this email is to confirm the partners' meeting, which has been scheduled for next week. I look forward to hearing about the outcomes. Kind regards, Brad.

Hi team, please disregard the previous meeting confirmation for Thursday at 2:30 PM. This meeting has been canceled due to a scheduling conflict. I will send a new confirmation once a suitable time has been found. My apologies for any confusion. Kind regards, Brad.
